name: Transaction Totals 6
definition: Additional count which may be utilised for reconciliation.

Authorisation.name: Authorisation
Authorisation.definition: Sum number of all authorisation transactions.

AuthorisationReversal.name: Authorisation Reversal
AuthorisationReversal.definition: Sum number of all reversed authorisation transactions.

Inquiry.name: Inquiry
Inquiry.definition: Sum number of all inquiry transactions.

InquiryReversal.name: Inquiry Reversal
InquiryReversal.definition: Sum number of all reversed inquiry transactions.

Payments.name: Payments
Payments.definition: Sum number of all financial presentment payment transactions processed.

PaymentReversal.name: Payment Reversal
PaymentReversal.definition: Sum number of all financial presentment payment transactions which have been reversed.

Transfer.name: Transfer
Transfer.definition: Sum number of all financial presentment transactions processed.

TransferReversal.name: Transfer Reversal
TransferReversal.definition: Sum number of all reversal transactions processed.

FeeCollection.name: Fee Collection
FeeCollection.definition: Sum number of all fee collection transactions.
